title: [Jolt Physics] using Joint3D to simulate grab-and-drag behavior makes all joint connected objects phase through other physics objects
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.stable.mono

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable.mono - Bazzite 43.20260101.0 (Kinoite) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7600 XT (RADV NAVI33) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.25 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using Jolt Physics, trying to use joints to pick up and drag objects around based on user input results in most collisions with jointed physics objects not resolving correctly, phasing through or exerting almost no force on non-jointed object. This behavior is not present in GodotPhysics3D.

### Steps to reproduce

I use this code to implement grab-and-drag

```gdscript
extends Node3D

@export var grab_point: StaticBody3D
@export var grab_camera: Node3D

@export var _grab_joint: Joint3D

var _grabbed: Node3D
var _grabbed_relative_pos = Vector3.ZERO

func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	grab_point.position = grab_camera.global_position + -grab_camera.basis.z.normalized() * 3.0
	#if _grabbed != null:
		#_grab_joint.position = _grabbed.position + _grabbed_relative_pos
	
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("grab"):
		grab_from(grab_camera.position, grab_camera.position + -grab_camera.basis.z.normalized() * 6.0, [])
	
	if !Input.is_action_pressed("grab"):
		release_grab()

func grab_from(grab_pos: Vector3, target: Vector3, exclude: Array[RID] = []):
	var space_state = get_world_3d().direct_space_state
	
	var ray_query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(grab_pos, target)
	ray_query.exclude = exclude
	var ray_result = space_state.intersect_ray(ray_query)
	if !ray_result.is_empty():
		if ray_result.collider is RigidBody3D:
			_grab_joint.reparent(ray_result.collider, false)
			_grab_joint.position = ray_result.position - ray_result.collider.global_position
			_grabbed = ray_result.collider
			_grab_joint.node_a = ray_result.collider.get_path()
			_grab_joint.node_b = grab_point.get_path()
			print("Grabbed ", _grabbed.name)
			_grabbed_relative_pos = ray_result.position - _grabbed.position
	
func release_grab():
	_grab_joint.node_a = ""
```
